identities.name: SPO-2 suberin/tall-oil-polyol rigid polyurethane foam (Ivdre 2024)
identities.identity_scope: Study-defined SPO-2 rigid polyurethane formulation based on synthesized suberinic-acid/tall-oil-derived polyols. The Table 9 inputs are 67 g SA-C_TOFA(50:50)/TMP and 33 g SA-E_ETOFA(50:50)/TMP, unlike the existing LPO-1 Lupranol 3300/3422 formulation. This is one selected representative of the SP formulation series, not all suberin-derived polyurethane foams. SPO-2 is a study label, not a certified grade. Do not count SPO-1/SPO-3, LPO-2/LPO-3, cure times, specimens or translations as extra identities in this packet. No final molecular formula, purity, elemental composition or universal material equivalence is inferred.

evidence.locator: Section 2.4; Section 3.3 Table 9, SPO-2 column; Section 3.4 Table 10

records.source_designation: SPO-2, Table 9 formulation and Table 10 experimental characterization

product_form.text: Optimized free-rise rigid foam cast in a 30 × 30 × 10 cm mold

processing.text: Polyol components mechanically mixed about 2 min at 2000 rpm; physical blowing agent added last and mixed about 1 min; pMDI mixed 10 s before pouring

temper_or_heat_treatment.notes: Not reported for the selected source result.

conditioning.text: Cured for 24 h at room temperature before additional testing
conditioning.notes: Cure conditions are not density-test conditions.

composition_or_purity.text: Table 9 SPO-2 formulation inputs: SA-C_TOFA(50:50)/TMP 67 g; SA-E_ETOFA(50:50)/TMP 33 g; total water 0.5 g; Opteon 1100 24.3 g; Polycat NP10 1.55 g; PC CAT TKA 30 0.5 g; Niax Silicone L-6915 2.5 g; TCPP 20 g; pMDI (Desmodur 44 V20 L) 102 g. Table footnotes state TCPP was adjusted to 8 wt.% of total foam mass and pMDI to NCO/OH ratio 1.2.

evidence.locator: §2.4 and Table 9 SPO-2 column and footnotes

composition_or_purity.notes: These are formulation inputs, not a measured cured-foam elemental composition or purity certification. Table 9 calls the catalyst Polycat NP10 while Section 2.4 uses PC CAT NP10; retain source naming without independent supplier-equivalence certification. The 50:50 figures describe each precursor feed; 67/33 g is the selected foam polyol input ratio.

reinforcement.notes: No quantitative reinforcement specification is assigned to this selected source-qualified material.

evidence.locator: Table 10, SPO-2 / Closed cell content; §2.8 ISO 4590:2016

porosity.notes: Closed-cell content is not total porosity. Do not set total void fraction to 95%.

orientation.notes: Direction is not applicable to this scalar mass-density selection; no isotropy is established.
